name: @workspace-clients/chat-desktop
//capabilities: device-session, hub-control and approval-surface are the whole required set. device-session is how the window reaches the Personal workspace, where the conversation, its agents and its approvals live; hub-control is how it finds that workspace (the account's hub lists it); approval-surface is the right to answer the approvals those agents raise from inside the chat window. native-menus is optional: without it the window keeps its sidebar controls and only loses the File menu entries. There is no panel-hosting (the chat hosts no panels), and none of notifications, clipboard or open-external is asked for yet: nothing in this client calls them, and a capability is requested only with the code that uses it.
//intents: open-conversation has no dynamic entries: no workspace service lists recent conversations yet, so a launcher offers a plain Chat entry and the conversation list lives inside the window. ask is the same background handler chat-terminal and chat-mobile declare.

vibestudio.description: Talk with agents in your workspace in a window of its own: your conversations beside the transcript, approvals answered in place.

//devDependencies: @testing-library/react renders through @testing-library/dom and declares it as a peer rather than depending on it, so it has to be named here: the build installs what manifests declare and never adds a package on the registry's behalf.
